description: Create a new network interface in a VPC subnet. vpcNo, subnetNo and 1-3 ACG numbers are required. Use dryRun=true to preview.

accessControlGroupNoList.description: List of ACG numbers to apply (1-3)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating

ip.description: Primary private IP within the subnet range (auto-assigned when omitted; the first 6 and the last subnet addresses are reserved)

isBareMetal.description: true for a bare-metal server interface (requires serverInstanceNo)

networkInterfaceName.description: Network interface name (3-30 chars: lowercase letters, digits, '-'; auto-generated when omitted)

secondaryIpCount.description: Number of secondary IPs to auto-assign (0-5)

secondaryIpList.description: Secondary IPs to assign (together with secondaryIpCount at most 5)

serverInstanceNo.description: Server instance to attach to on creation (private-subnet interfaces only)

subnetNo.description: Subnet number to create the network interface in (required)

vpcNo.description: VPC number the subnet belongs to (required; see ncloud_list_vpcs)

name: ncloud_create_network_interface
